facts.fact: AUDA-NEPAD launched its Programme for African Developing Island Economies on 24 July 2026 at the STC-TTIM Ministerial Segment in Abidjan, covering Seychelles among seven island states, with digital transformation one of six pillars; ministers adopted a communiqué committing to it.
